week_subtitle: From Sunday Gravy to Saturday kimchi, one brisket feeds the whole week
theme: Comfort food remixed across five cultures
weather_summary: Cold early week (27-41°F) warming to 60°F by Saturday. Light rain and drizzle most days with sunny breaks.
special_notes: After school programs Wed (Science Potions) and Thu (Dance Camp)
Kiet picks up kids on Wednesday (early release)
Airbrush Art & Swimming Egg Hunt Saturday 9:45 AM - 2:45 PM (bring lunch)

days.name: Sunday 03/15
days.weather_detail: Cloudy (26% sunshine), 68% cloud cover, 28% precip, gusts 34 mph
days.dinner_description: Italian-American Sunday Gravy with pork ribs, sausage, and beef in slow-simmered tomato sauce over pasta
days.album_description: The album that fused Afrobeat with new wave, produced by Brian Eno. Polyrhythmic perfection.
days.album_sonic_description: Post-punk meets Afrobeat with layered polyrhythms, looping guitar, driving bass
days.album_pairing_rationale: Sunday Gravy is a layered, slow-building project. Polyrhythmic grooves keep energy up during hours of stirring and tasting.

days.name: Monday 03/16
days.weather_detail: 100% cloud, 82% precip, 1.20 inch rain expected, gusts 39 mph
days.dinner: Mujadara (Lentils and Rice with Crispy Onions)
days.dinner_description: Spiced green lentils and basmati rice topped with crispy fried onions, served with herbed yogurt
days.album_description: The Afrobeat masterpiece. Fela’s searing critique of the Nigerian military over 12 minutes of hypnotic groove.
days.album_sonic_description: Classic Afrobeat with extended polyrhythmic grooves, horn riffs, call-and-response
days.album_pairing_rationale: Both mujadara and Fela are deceptively simple. One groove, one pot. Both reward patience.

days.name: Tuesday 03/17
days.weather_detail: Sunny (92% sunshine), 44% cloud, cold and clear, gusts 33 mph
days.dinner_description: The family signature dish: silky fresh pasta with spinach puree and golden egg yolks, brown butter and Parmesan
days.album_description: The definitive Irish punk party album. Fiddle-driven energy that is impossible to sit still through.
days.album_sonic_description: Irish folk-punk with fiddle, accordion, banjo, and tin whistle over punk rock rhythms
days.album_pairing_rationale: St. Patrick’s Day demands Irish energy. Flogging Molly fills the house while Elsie helps roll green pasta on the greenest day of the year.

days.name: Wednesday 03/18
days.weather_detail: Sunny (91% sunshine), 64% cloud, coldest night at 27°F, calm 9 mph
days.dinner: Corned Beef and Cabbage with Potatoes and Carrots
days.dinner_description: Salt-cured brisket slow-braised with cabbage wedges, waxy potatoes, and sweet carrots. Served with whole-grain mustard.
days.album: Dropkick Murphys — Sing Loud, Sing Proud!
days.album_description: Boston Celtic punk anthems with bagpipes and power chords. Turns any room into a rowdy Irish pub.
days.album_sonic_description: Celtic punk with bagpipes, tin whistles, mandolins over driving punk guitar and thunderous drums
days.album_pairing_rationale: Irish punk for Irish dinner. Both are proudly working-class, unapologetically loud, and perfect for a cold night.
calendar_items: Early Release — Kiet picks up kids

days.name: Thursday 03/19
days.weather_detail: Mostly Sunny (84% sunshine), 96% cloud, calm 9 mph
days.dinner: Corned Beef Tacos with Pickled Onions and Mustard Crema
days.dinner_description: Shredded leftover corned beef in flour tortillas with quick-pickled red onions, shredded cabbage, and bright mustard crema
days.album_description: Psychedelic soul from East LA. Tropicalia, funk, and R&B swirling through a Chicano lens.
days.album_sonic_description: Psychedelic soul with vintage organ, smooth bass, funky drums, and falsetto vocals
days.album_pairing_rationale: Fusion tacos demand fusion music. Chicano Batman blends Mexican-American soul like the Irish-Mexican mashup on the plate.

days.name: Friday 03/20
days.weather_detail: Mostly Sunny (78% sunshine), 78% cloud, warming up, gusts 32 mph
days.dinner_description: Composed dinner salad with roasted chickpeas, avocado, soft-boiled eggs, Parmesan, pepitas, pickled beets, and lemon-tahini dressing
days.album_description: Brooklyn disco-soul trio channeling Chic and Sister Sledge with modern flair.
days.album_sonic_description: Vintage disco-soul with lush strings, funky bass, and gorgeous three-part vocal harmonies
days.album_pairing_rationale: No school, no rush. Disco grooves match the light, fresh energy of a vegetarian dinner. Dancing in the kitchen.

days.name: Saturday 03/21
days.weather_detail: Sunny (89% sunshine), 91% cloud, warmest night, gusts 34 mph
days.dinner: Corned Beef Kimchi Fried Rice Bowls
days.dinner_description: Day-old rice stir-fried with leftover corned beef, kimchi, gochujang, and sesame oil, topped with a fried egg
days.album: Hiatus Kaiyote — Love Heart Cheat Code
days.album_description: Melbourne’s genre-defying quartet at their most adventurous. Neo-soul, jazz, electronic, R&B in beautiful collision.
days.album_sonic_description: Future soul with intricate polyrhythms, jazz harmony, electronic textures, and acrobatic vocals
days.album_pairing_rationale: Korean fusion bowls demand genre-fusion music. Hiatus Kaiyote remixes traditions into something entirely new, just like corned beef meets kimchi.
